responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exports the low-level tree query and unwrapping helpers implemented by m2tree.cc. It defines the Tree foreign type and the predicates and skip routines that let Modula-2-side code recognize constants, ordinals, variables, arrays, and types and peel declaration wrappers from GCC tree nodes.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2tree group: it defines the foreign Tree type and exports the query/skip helpers to Modula-2 code, unlike m2tree.h's C/C++ declarations and m2tree.cc's actual predicate and unwrapping implementation.
